tags.name: AnalyticsService
tags.description:
AnalyticsService provides pre-aggregated metrics for dashboards:
throughput, latency distributions, failure rates, step duration
breakdowns, and failure heatmaps.

tags.name: GatewayService
tags.description:
GatewayService enables subsystem FlowWatch instances to register with a
central gateway via a persistent bidirectional stream. The gateway maintains
a registry of connected subsystems and proxies UI requests to them.

tags.name: RunService
tags.description:
RunService provides CRUD access to workflow runs, step-level detail,
and lifecycle actions (retry, cancel, pause, skip).

─── Queries ───

tags.name: SearchService
tags.description:
SearchService provides full-text search across runs, steps, payloads,
and logs with faceted filtering and a structured query language.

tags.name: StreamService
tags.description:
StreamService provides real-time server-streaming RPCs.
Connect-Go exposes these as Server-Sent Events (SSE) over HTTP,
making them consumable from browsers without WebSocket libraries.

tags.name: WorkflowService
tags.description:
WorkflowService provides read access to workflow definitions,
graph topology, and engine capability negotiation.
